stemMarkdown: In what ratio must a solution containing 31% acid be mixed with a solution containing 67% acid to obtain a mixture that is 51% acid? Give the ratio (cheaper : dearer) in simplest form, e.g. '3:2'.
solutionMarkdown: By alligation: $\dfrac{\text{cheaper}}{\text{dearer}} = \dfrac{y - z}{z - x} = \dfrac{67 - 51}{51 - 31} = \dfrac{16}{20} = 4:5$ (after simplifying by dividing both terms by 4).
